habit.description: After blocking two hits in a row the Kappa grabs. Stop at one hit, or jump or back off after the second block, and the throw whiffs.

notes: Anti-air (YOK-165): answers opponent_jumping with the generic throw (C4), the single attacking answer so jump_punish_pct sets the rate; no kappa-* normals exist yet, so it catches the jumper in landing frames (E19). Swap to a Kappa rising normal when one lands. Kappa patient (Y2): blocks, then throws after two blocked hits (that throw is the habit above). Kappa uses only generic actions (its throw is the generic throw, C4); data/moves/ has no kappa-* normals or clips yet, so it has no strikes of its own. When they land, add pokes. No ids invented.
